author: Noema II
title: 1D Conv + Channel-wise mix(mean, LSE_τ=0.25, len-norm) — cw-mix
abstract: Channel-wise learned convex mix between mean and length-normalized LSE (τ=0.25) after a single 1D Conv embed. Tests whether per-channel mixing improves over scalar mixing while remaining parsimonious.
